opening_hook: Subah alarm baja, Aarav ne snooze dabaya, phir woh bola, kal nahi, aaj ek page se start karunga.
narration: Subah alarm baja, Aarav ne snooze dabaya, phir woh bola, kal nahi, aaj ek page se start karunga. Exam paas tha, kitaab saamne thi, par first page kholna mushkil laga; notes untouched, mind tired tha. Phone phir chamka, notifications aaye, aur woh scroll karne laga; phir usne apna timer set kiya, bas itna hi. Is baar, usne phone side rakha aur sirf ek page padha; lines confusing thi, lekin Aarav ne slowly read kiya, sentence by sentence. Page khatam hua, exam abhi bhi baaki tha, par Aarav ko thoda confidence mila; kal ke liye usne next small step likha, and smiled.
